notes: Job Agent v2.9.16 beta introduces a human-controlled employer response tracker for submitted applications. In the Dashboard, confirmed submitted vacancies now expose 'Отметить ответ работодателя…' where the user can separately record awaiting reply, recruiter contacted, interview scheduled, interview completed, rejection, offer or withdrawal, with notes and an optional next date/time. A new 'Ответы работодателей' filter surfaces recorded replies, and the vacancy detail/row displays their stage. All recruitment progress is manual, stored atomically in ~/.job_agent/employer_responses.json independently from historical applications.csv and all application statuses; it never sends email or changes employer final-submit safeguards. The previous v2.9.15 run verified the Master Data Specialist false employer badge issue was fixed ('company not detected' rather than 'Domů' or 'Top Employer 2026'); 173 discovered, 104 scored, 10 REVIEW, 0 APPLY, 42 previously processed, 1 pending manual Sanofi Jobs.cz handoff. No background email access or auto-replies. GitHub Actions 81/81 offline tests passed including UI and persistence safety regressions.
